title: Paladin Fintech KYC integration scrapbook
content:
Context:
- Paladin Fintech: mid-size payments processor, strong compliance bar (EU + US), prefers VPC/private deploy for PII flow. They want an LLM-backed KYC assistant to triage new account docs and surface high-risk cases to human reviewers.
- Meeting 2024-09-11 w/ Paladin eng + risk + infra. This is my raw capture — will tidy later.

High-level requirements (as heard):
- Inference on private network (VPC peering or on-prem appliance). No PII to leave their VPC unless redacted/hashed.
- Keys via customer-managed KMS (HSM-compatible preferred).
- Audit logs for every request (request/response hashes ok, but need recoverable mappings for audits). 12-month retention for security logs, 7 years for compliance traces (legal to confirm).
- Latency target: 300–500ms p95 for single-record triage path (short prompts). Bulk backfill allowed to be lower priority.
- Throughput expected initially ~25 qps with spikes to 100 qps during onboarding; plan for burst capacity.
- Deterministic embedding ID for document dedup & historical matching.
- Streaming output not required for triage, but useful for human-in-loop UI during review.

Notable constraints / gotchas mentioned:
- Paladin uses a strict egress policy: only HTTPS through their proxy. We need static IPs for outbound telemetry or an egress arrangement (ask infra).
- Their SSO is Okta, want SCIM provisioning + SAML SSO to Redwood Console. Also need RBAC mapping for reviewer vs admin roles.
- Data residency: EU customer records must stay in eu-west-1 region. They asked if Redwood can pin model serving regionally (yes, but mention dedicated capacity or private deploy).
- They have internal PII redaction rules that remove id numbers but keep names; product needs a post-LLM redaction step in case model echoes. Consider deterministic redaction via preprocessing + response sanitization hooks.
- Logging: security wants full conversation hashes, but legal is worried about raw text storage. Propose: store salted hashes + encrypted blobs with HSM keys that Paladin controls.

Technical architecture ideas (sketch):
- Private deploy inside Paladin VPC (customer-managed control plane) with Redwood runtime in k8s nodes. Use sidecar for pre/post-processing:
  * Pre: redaction, tokenization, PII markers, conversation enrichment (customer metadata).
  * Runtime: quantized model variant for latency/cost (benchmarking needed).
  * Post: deterministic embedding generation, text normalization, redact buffer check.
- Smart routing hybrid: host triage on Dedicated nodes inside VPC; fallback to Redwood-hosted overlay for non-PII workflows (e.g., model tuning synthetic data).
- Cache: KV prefix caching for repeated identity templates (e.g., standard forms) — TTL 24h initially. Beware: caching touches PII; must be encrypted and gated by policy.

Performance / cost roughs (very rough):
- Required: 25 qps sustained, spikes to 100 qps for 2–3 hr/day. If using g4dn-like nodes (for planning) expect baseline dedicated cluster of 4 GPUs with autoscale to 12 for spikes.
- Model choice: mid-sized open model (7–13B) quantized to int8/4 gives decent latency for triage. Need to run evals on Paladin sample prompts (request dataset) to estimate tokens per request.

Open questions / follow-ups for Paladin:
1) Legal: exact retention windows (logs vs payload vs embeddings). Who signs for audit export? (Assigned: Maya)
2) Infra: how strictly enforced are egress static IP requirements? Can they allow peered VPC endpoints to Redwood control plane? (Assigned: Ravi)
3) Security: confirm HSM vendor + required FIPS level. Do they want wrap/unwrap only or full envelope encryption? (Assigned: Ava)
4) Product: does Paladin want streaming websocket for live review, or is polling enough? UI team to weigh in. (Assigned: Noah)
5) Data sample: request a redacted sample of 200 triage records to run throughput and quality evals. Need ETA from Paladin (action item).

Action items (concrete next steps):
- Send onboarding checklist + private-deploy checklist to Paladin (this week). Owner: Ava.
- Set up PoC env: v1 with 2 GPU nodes in Paladin test VPC (sandbox peering). Owner: Ravi. Target: 2024-10-04 for initial sandbox smoke.
- Security deep-dive: HSM/KMS spec sheet + suggested encryption flow doc. Owner: Maya. Due: 2024-09-25.
- Create prompt set + eval harness scaffold for KYC triage (20 gold-labeled examples). Owner: Product eng (Noah to coordinate). Due: 2024-09-27.
- Cost sketch for Dedicated vs Private (monthly committed + burst) incl. estimates for 25 qps baseline. Owner: Solutions eng cost team. Due: 2024-09-30.

Quick notes — things I want to test in PoC:
- How Redwood prefix KV caching affects p95 when same form template repeated; measure false positive rate when caching normalized fillers.
- Response sanitization hook latency (should be <50ms). If too slow, move to async sanitization + fallback redaction blocking.
- Embedding determinism: run 50 repeated embeddings for same doc to check float jitter with quantized model (seed & stable tokenization).
- Canary fallback policy: if private cluster CPU queue grows > X ms, fallback to hosted variant with metric-based approval (legal ok?).

Conversation highlights / quotes to remember:
- Risk lead: "We can't rely on any third party storing raw IDs — if it's stored we need our key." -> HSM requirement.
- Eng lead: "Latency is important but accuracy for risk triage is more important — don't over-prioritize tiny ms wins if recall drops."

Loose prompts/examples (to use in eval):
- "Given these doc fields (name, dob, id type, id number, address), return a single label: low/medium/high risk with 1-sentence rationale and up to 2 flags (e.g., mismatched address, disposable email)."
- Try structured JSON output with fields: label, rationale, flags[]. Validate strict-schema.

Risks & mitigations:
- Echoed PII in LLM responses -> mitigation: post-response scrubber, redact heuristics, deny-list tokens.
- Cost blowouts in spikes -> mitigation: set burst caps + cost-alerts + autoscale cooldowns.
- Audit/legal mismatch on what we store -> mitigation: encrypted blobs w/ customer keys + feature toggle to only store hashes.

Misc scribbles / heuristics:
- Prefer deterministic tokenizers (SentencePiece with fixed vocab) for embeddings consistency.
- For dedup, use embedding cosine + doc-hash with salted customer key.
- Keep one fast path (short prompt, mid-size model) and one high-accuracy path (longer prompt, larger model) — route by policy.

Meeting log + attendees:
- 2024-09-11: Paladin (Sarah Cole - Risk, Viktor Ilyin - Eng, Leena Rao - Infra), Redwood (Ava Martinez, Ravi Patel, Maya Singh, Noah Kim)

Next touchpoints:
- Send internal deck + security brief to Paladin contacts by 2024-09-15 (Ava).
- Set tentative on-site runbook review for 2024-10-07 (align with Paladin infra availability).

Status: draft — lots of TODOs and legal/infrastructure dependencies. Use this as my single-source raw capture; will carve into PoC ticket backlog once security answers come back.

Notes to self:
- Follow up in slack thread #paladin-onramp for quick replies; keep escalation path to Eng-SRE for egress IP requests.
- Add Paladin-specific RBAC mapping template to repo: auth/saml-mappings/paladin.yaml

End of capture.
